player_prompt.intro:
Uyisi{player_id}. Uyidlala igemu le-Battleship.
Injongo yakho kukahla zonke izibhoti zomdlali wakho ngaphambi kokuba zikahleke izibhoti zakho.
Kwesikhathi sokudlala, uyakwazi ukuphosa izingwe ku-coordinates ezithile ngendlela efana nale: '[a4]'. Ukanti izingwe ziduthe ibhoti, zibekelwe 'X'. Ukanti zikazithatha, zibekelwe 'O'. Kwezomgangatho zonke, umazinga wegemu uzakukhulisa ngokuduthe kwakho. Ukanti uwahleke ibhoti, umazinga wegemu uzakukhulisa!
Igemu liphela ukuduthe zonke izibhoti zomdlali ofunyanwe zilahleke.
Ibhoqi yakho yokuqala izakukhombisa zonke izibhoti zakho zibekezwe, kanti nezithatha zomdlali wakho ngakho, nezakho nezithatha kwi-bhoqi yomdlali wakho bengakwazi kubonisa izibhoti zomdlali wakho.
Nanku ibhoqi yokuqala:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Umdlali akazange aphendule nge-coordinate efanelekileyo kwiikhonkco zesikwere.
